Cow Dung Dewatering Machine

Enquire on WhatsAppContact Us
About This Machine

The Dewatering Machine is a crucial step in cow dung processing. It effectively separates liquid from raw cow dung, yielding a semi-dry solid output that is perfect for composting, log making, or briquetting, while the liquid can be used as organic liquid fertilizer.
